title: dat0 package manifest (format v1)
description: Ratified schema for the `manifest.json` entry of a `.dat0` package. See docs/dat0-format-v1.md §3.

format_version.description: Package format major version. MUST be 1 for this schema.

dat0_version.description: Version of the dat0 build that produced this package.

created_at.description: Package creation timestamp. Opaque string — producers SHOULD use RFC 3339; readers MUST treat it as opaque (the dat0 app writes epoch-seconds).

table_count.description: Number of tables in the recipe.

checksums.description: Map of in-archive entry path -> "sha256:<hex>". MUST cover every data/*.parquet entry and recipe.json; writers since QA4 also cover sources.json, views.json, queries.json and charts.json. Readers verify exactly the entries listed here, so a longer map is strictly stronger and an older package listing fewer entries remains valid.
